name: MILES
intro: 我是 MILES，AI 视频创作者。从人物、产品和场景资产出发，把想法推进成镜头，再通过剪辑连成故事。关注产品质感、人物连续性，也关注每一帧里的情绪。
enIntro: I'm MILES, an AI video creator based in Shenzhen. I work from character, product and scene assets through to moving images and editing — with a focus on texture, continuity and emotion.

projects.title: 珠宝产品质感
projects.description: 祖母绿戒指暗场短片。从产品资产到动态镜头，重点控制宝石颜色、金属结构、光影与镜头连续性。
projects.enDescription: An emerald ring in a dark setting. From product assets to moving images, with attention to gemstone color, metal structure, lighting and continuity.
projects.scope: 资产整理、动态生成、剪辑与成片
projects.enScope: Asset preparation, AI video generation & editing
